entities.name: Franciscan Abbey, Rothenburg ob der Tauber
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Franciscan Friary of Rothenburg ob der Tauber is a former friary of the Conventual Franciscans in the town of Rothenburg ob der Tauber in Bavaria in the diocese of Bamberg. Nowadays the former Franciscan church is an Evangelical Lutheran parish church.
